act: Indian Stamp Act, 1899 (as applicable to Delhi), Schedule I-A

source.ref: Indian Stamp Act, 1899, Sch. I-A Art. 40(b) (Delhi)
source.quoted_text: Schedule I-A Art. 40 (Mortgage Deed), clause (b): 'when possession is not given or agreed to be given as aforesaid — 2% with a monetary ceiling of Rs. 2 lacs [Rs 2,00,000].' (Clause (a), where possession IS given, is charged as a Conveyance No.23 on the amount secured; clause (c) collateral security is Rs 2 per Rs 1,000.)

notes_for_reviewer: CONFIDENCE: MEDIUM (Schedule I-A reproduction; both columns coherent). 2% of the amount secured, capped at Rs 2,00,000. Self-contained (no cross-ref). Mortgage WITHOUT possession is NOT in the DMC s.147 transfer-duty list (founder Q1) — no transfer-duty modifier, correctly. The companion mortgage WITH possession is now encoded separately (DL-ART40a) per the resolved Q1 ruling. Clause (c) collateral/auxiliary security (Rs 2 per Rs 1,000) not yet encoded — questionnaire fork.
